mapper.select: select member_Id, name,password, nickname, email, profile_image, phone_number, birthDate, gender from member_tb ORDER BY member_Id
mapper.update: update member_tb set name=#{name}, nickname=#{nickname}, email=#{email} ,profile_image = #{profile_image} ,phone_number=#{phone_number} , birthDate = TO_DATE(#{birthDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),gender=#{gender} where member_Id=#{member_Id}
